variables.systemDescription: The Sega Chihiro is an arcade system produced by Sega in 2003 as a successor to the Naomi arcade system. The Microsoft Xbox is based on the Chihiro design, but the Chihiro supports up to 1GB of RAM and uses GD-ROM media instead of DVDs. In theory, Chihiro's PowerPC architecture allowed for easier porting of games to the Xbox, contributing to its significance in the evolution of arcade gaming technology.
